metadata: Native glove material parameters collected from original .vcompmat/.vmat definitions.
exporter: Source 2 Viewer CLI 20.1; Sharp0.35.5 lossless WebP
compositor: No browser-compatible exact Valve material compositor bake available in the CLI export workflow. Original native layer inputs are supplied for the browser layered material implementation; alpha-packed texture data is separated from color during export.
ownership: Valve and original Workshop contributors retain ownership. No generated artwork.
